Octabam v0.5, built from tag `v0.5` (`4975ebf0`). Octatrack OS 1.40C patched with one of three remixes, `octabam`, `octabam-verbs` or `octabam-bus`; the build runs in the browser on your own copy of 1.40C. The builder page has a **Remix** picker, and each remix has its own overview page and manual.

Build and install: https://sambanks.github.io/octabam/web-builder.html

Changes from v0.4 (`octabam`):
- New modules: SCOPE, SCALES, WAVE (a ColdFire machine), CHORDS FACTORY with PAGES, SCREEN, SLOW LFO, BAR LED, REC CS1 SKIP, KEYBUS with SC KEYBUS BRIDGE, FRAME GUARD and REMOTE.
- EUCLID FILL is renamed SEQ. RAND is the default phrase; JUMP spacing applies to RAND; RAND spacing is kept at DEPTH edges.
- PATTERN MUTE keeps its state in CS1 and `pmute.work` (#1143).
- BRAIN's switch copy is fixed (#1134).
- [BANK] lights trigless locks that carry a locked parameter (`batch-bugfixes` pin `2cd3109`). Erasing empty trigless locks works on MIDI tracks too (`erase-empty-trigless-locks` pin `2cd3109`).
- SHATTER's constants load as short immediates.

New remixes:
- `octabam-verbs`: `octabam` with VERBERATION in place of the stock reverbs, plus TRANSIENT, VIBRATO and RESONATOR. Its image is named `OCTABAM-VRB <tag>`.
- `octabam-bus`: the bus remix in the builder.

Measured on Sam's MKII, 22 Nov 2026 (the three images from `main` at `382a478b` plus the release commit, booted by REMIX SWITCH, not flashed):
- `pre-meter`, `pre-transport`, `pre-usb` and `dsp-watch` pass on all three.
- Loader soak, 32 program-change transitions: 3 unapplied on `octabam`, 0 on `octabam-verbs`, 0 on `octabam-bus`.
- `mix-soak` did not complete on any.

Known fault in `octabam`: with MODULATION loaded in T3's block, a program change that puts DARK REV on all 8 tracks, then START, stops the DSP frame count. A power-cycle clears it. The cause is not known (`docs/contributing/FAILURE_MODES.md`). `octabam-verbs` carries no stock DARK REV and `octabam-bus` no loader.

Not run on a unit: module changes that reached `main` after `382a478b`.

No Elektron files are attached. The web builder patches are in `docs/site/builder/patches/` in the repository, added after the tag in `af735daf`:
